scenario: I and a fellow researcher have discovered a powerful new energy source that is cheap, safe, and clean. It has the potential to put an end to pollution and poverty in the world. However, my colleague wants to sell the discovery and I know that he is planning to contact the potential buyers by email today. I also know for sure that the latter will use the invention as a deadly weapon, but my colleague doesn’t believe me. If I release a flammable gas in the lab, it will cause an explosion when my colleague turns on his computer. This will kill him, but I will save thousands of people.
choice: I decide to cause the computer of your colleague to explode releasing the flammable gas
entities: i,my colleague / fellow researcher,potential buyers,thousands of people who would otherwise be killed by the weapon
outcomes: The lab is damaged by the explosion
The email to the potential buyers is not sent that day
I am placed in danger from the explosion
